video.title: INNODIGYM vs Speediance: Smart Home Gym Comparison
video.description:
INNODIGYM vs Speediance: which smart home gym would I consider buying today? In this livestream, I compare the INNODIGYM OMNI X1 Pro with Speediance Gym Monster models and explain how price, resistance, software reliability and workout setup affect my choice.

We also look at AEKE, Tonal, AMP and Vitruvian, and answer questions about beginner-friendly training, adjustable arms, subscriptions and when a coach or training partner may be a better fit than another machine.

Topics covered:
• INNODIGYM pricing, resistance and folding/storage considerations
• Speediance Gym Monster model differences and software updates
• AEKE as an alternative for beginners
• Subscription costs and the features I value
• Arm adjustments, workout transitions and accountability

Recorded live on October 8, 2026. This is my personal commentary and a screen-based comparison, rather than a hands-on test of every device shown. Prices, offers, software and product specifications reflect the discussion at recording time and may change; confirm current details with the manufacturers.

Which smart home gym are you considering, and what matters most to you? Leave your questions in the comments.

Subscribe to Toby Glenn for more Toby on Fitness Tech discussions.
